evidence.name: Screen field: Background behind the wheels
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Background behind the wheels" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Background behind the wheels
sections.description: Fill color behind the spinning wheels (default white, #ffffff). Choose a color that contrasts enough with the screen background so the picker reads as its own distinct card and the wheel values stay legible. A subtle off-white or light tint often separates the picker from the page better than pure white.
